# Figure index (auto-generated by 06_figures.py)

See analysis_report.md section 7 for per-figure interpretation and caveats.

- **F01_profile_by_blur.png** — Success@3px (top) and GT-correct@3px (bottom) per blur condition for each group; dashed = clean baseline. Facets = detector. Test split, 24 pairs per point.
- **F02_paired_effects_forest.png** — Paired within-cell differences (treatment minus A) per blur condition with sequence-cluster bootstrap 95% CI. Top: success@3px; bottom: GT-correct@3px. B-A only for ORB (SIFT tuned == default).
- **F03_processing_effects_all_metrics.png** — C-A (unsharp, orange) and D-A (Wiener, aqua) per blur for six metrics; CI = sequence-cluster bootstrap. Shows the unsharp dissociation: for motion blur PSNR falls while Edge F1 / repeatability rise and matching is flat.
- **F04_psnr_ssim_vs_edgef1.png** — Image-level scatter: PSNR (left) / SSIM (right) vs Edge F1 for all 576 processed test images; colour = processing, marker = blur family. Motion-blurred images (triangles) sit at low PSNR but high Edge F1.
- **F05_metrics_vs_log_gt_ratio.png** — Each metric vs clean-normalised log GT-correct ratio, rows = detector, 576 rows (A/C/D) per detector. Repeatability shows the tightest relation; Edge F1 the loosest.
- **F06_predictor_comparison.png** — How well each metric tracks matching performance under three dependence-aware views. Left: pooled rank correlation; middle: per-pair correlation across blur conditions; right: within-cell fixed-effects R2 (both detectors pooled).
- **F07_heatmap_pair_blur.png** — Per-pair x blur map of the retained fraction of GT-correct matches (processed / clean) for A (left) and D (right); red x = homography failure@3px. Dark = close to clean level, light = almost nothing retained. i_ = illumination, v_ = viewpoint.
- **F08_orientation_asymmetry.png** — Clean-image gradient orientation (x) vs the 0deg-minus-90deg difference under 17px motion blur for PSNR, Edge F1 and SIFT GT-correct matches (24 pairs). Image-quality asymmetry is a scene property; the matching asymmetry is not predicted by it.
- **F09_orb_tuning_tradeoff.png** — ORB tuned (scaleFactor 1.2, nlevels 12, fastThreshold 20) minus default, per blur: keypoints, ratio-test matches, GT-correct matches and match precision, with cluster-bootstrap CI.
- **F10_h_error_ecdf.png** — Empirical CDF of the mean grid projection error per group (failures / undefined placed at the right end). Dotted lines: 3 px and 5 px success thresholds.
- **F11_edge_precision_recall.png** — Mean edge precision vs recall per blur condition; arrows from the blurred image to unsharp (orange) and Wiener (aqua). Blur removes recall, not precision; unsharp buys recall with lower precision; Wiener restores recall at ~0.99 precision.
- **F12_effects_by_sequence_type.png** — Pooled treatment effects split by sequence type (12 pairs each); CI = cluster bootstrap over 6 sequences per type, so intervals are wide.
- **F13_keypoint_counts.png** — Mean number of detected target keypoints per blur condition and group. ORB saturates at the 1500 budget for mild blur; SIFT loses keypoints monotonically (contrast threshold).
- **F14_slopegraph_motion17.png** — Per-pair trajectories of GT-correct matches from blurred (A) through unsharp (C) and Wiener (D) to the clean image, for the hardest condition (motion 17 px, 0deg).
